key_insight: A two-stage AI system measured glomerular areas with expert-comparable agreement, while detection approached inter-expert performance.
clinical_relevance: Automated glomerular measurement could support large-scale quantitative kidney pathology and research on nephron number estimation.
method: Faster R-CNN detected glomeruli in whole-slide kidney biopsy images.
DeepLabV3+ segmented detected glomeruli for area measurement.
Low-magnification measurements at 40× were compared with 400× measurements.
evidence_signal: Of 114 biopsies, 104 supported development and 10 independent final evaluation; AI achieved detection F1 0.851 versus expert agreement of 0.888, segmentation Dice 0.959, and area-measurement ICC 0.989.
watch_item: The independent evaluation included only 10 biopsies; broader validation is needed before routine clinical implementation.
paper_title: Development of a deep learning model for glomerulus detection and segmentation in kidney histopathology images
